method124 new-vis while bit_pos+21 < psize*8: 14-bit index with sentinel 16383, 11-bit type, signed 5-bit x/y, 1-bit jump, 1-bit extended; then byte-align

method222 per extended slot: one mask byte; bits 0x1 HITMARK2 four g1, 0x2 ANIM g2+g1, 0x4 FACEENTITY g2, 0x8 SAY gjstr, 0x10 HITMARK four g1, 0x20 CHANGETYPE g2, 0x40 SPOTANIM g2+g4, 0x80 FACESQUARE two g2
